findings.body: Deterministic top-1 tie-break (lowest expert index) documentation has been added to public Rust methods on RouterForwardOutput.
Training-loop ownership of stochastic-option construction has been clarified and assigned to owner beads bd-1ryn and bd-2v9r.
Phase defaults are correctly gated in model-core and producer wiring is appropriately marked as model-core helper support.

summary: The F-S7 task bead bd-1oc successfully implements expert dropout and logit jitter for Top1RouterQat with phase-gated defaults, deterministic seed/step/layer-id generation, and correct eval/export no-draw behavior. The code is well-structured and fully tested, including verification of tie-breaking determinism and z-loss/effective logit divergence. Prior review concerns regarding training-loop ownership and top-1 tie-break documentation have been fully addressed and resolved in the corrective closure-scope note and public Rust doc comments.
